title: Rule 7 decoder accepts overlong compressed residue at profile boundary
description: python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py reconstructs a MAX_PACKET_SIZE MQTT-SN Rule 7 packet from an encoded residue and accepts one extra trailing residue byte because only the reconstructed packet length is bounded after decoding. python/tests/schc/test_headers.py::test_mqtt_sn_rule7_profile_size_boundary now fails: compress_packet(max_size_raw) + 0x00 does not raise SchcError. Preserve the j2yt MAX_PACKET_SIZE uncompressed boundary while rejecting encoded residues whose complete consumption/reconstruction is non-canonical or exceeds the Rule 7 encoded bound. Add focused exact-boundary regressions, then run SCHC tests, Ruff, mypy, and 3x review convergence.
notes: Investigation showed the production decoder was correct under j2yt/spec: 22,554 is the encoded SCHC ceiling, and an extra MQTT-SN payload byte below that ceiling is indistinguishable from legitimate payload. The stale test incorrectly bounded reconstructed IPv6. Fix updates link-local and full-address regressions to construct exactly 22,554 encoded bytes and reject encoded max+1; no production limit change. Full python/tests/schc: 346 passed.
